Name: June sends schedule in the mail
Author: bananasalmon
Description:
[b][size=3]Introduction[/size][/b]
June from Ridgeside Village tells you his (rather complicated) schedule in a cutscene. This mod makes him send his schedule one day later by mail, so you can always find it in your collection tab. This idea came to me because it is another bachelor from an expansion mod with a quite complicated schedule. Earlier I have made [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26918]Lance sends schedule in the mail[/url] as well.

I kept the text as unedited from the cutscene as possible, because I am not the creator of this expansion or NPC. However I was a bit torn on maybe listing the schedule like Lance's mail.
Please let me know if this works for you, or if you rather have the letter listing his schedule like Lance's.

[size=3][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
Can be installed any time, if you have seen the cutscene already you will receive the mail the next day, even if it is Spring or Summer and June is not in the valley.

[b][size=3]Roadmap[/size][/b]
I don't think there is anything to add or improve. Suggestions are welcome.

[b][size=3]Translations[/size][/b]
